description: Implement guest referral tracking, cookie-based attribution, referral codes for alumni, and referral analytics

userStories.title: Prisma Schema Updates for Guest Referral System
acceptanceCriteria: Add GuestReferral model: id, referrerUserId (User who referred), referredUserId (new guest), referralCode used, status (CLICKED/APPLIED/BOOKED/COMPLETED), pointsEarned, createdAt
Add ReferralEvent model: id, referralCode, eventType (CLICK/APPLICATION/BOOKING/COMPLETION), userId (if known), ipAddress, userAgent, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, createdAt
Add referralCode field to User model (unique, nullable) - format: FIRSTNAME-YEAR
Add referralPointsBalance Int to User model for guest referral points
Add referralCodeClickCount Int to PartnerProfile for tracking
Run prisma generate and prisma db push
All TypeScript compiles without errors

userStories.title: Referral Link Tracking (Cookie-Based)
acceptanceCriteria: Create /r/[code] dynamic route that handles referral redirects
On visit: Set referral_code cookie with 30-day expiration
Store click event in ReferralEvent table with: code, timestamp, IP, user agent, UTM params
Increment click count on partner profile or user profile
First-click attribution: Don't overwrite existing cookie
Redirect to homepage after setting cookie
Handle invalid codes gracefully (redirect to homepage, no error)
All tests pass, TypeScript compiles

userStories.title: Referral Attribution at Application
acceptanceCriteria: Modify application submission to check for referral_code cookie
If cookie exists: Create ReferralEvent with type APPLICATION
Link application record to referral code (add referralCode field to Application model if needed)
Award 100 points to referrer (partner or guest)
Create points transaction record
Clear referral cookie after successful attribution
All tests pass, TypeScript compiles

userStories.title: Referral Attribution at Booking
acceptanceCriteria: Modify booking flow to check for referral_code cookie
Optional manual referral code input field at booking (fallback)
Manual code takes precedence over cookie if both exist
Validate referral code against database
Create ReferralEvent with type BOOKING
Award points based on package value: 1000 pts for packages under $15K, 1500 pts for $15K+
Update booking.referredBy with the referral code
Send notification email to referrer about successful booking
All tests pass, TypeScript compiles

userStories.title: Guest Referral Code Generation
acceptanceCriteria: After guest's first trip completes: Auto-generate referral code
Code format: FIRSTNAME-YEAR (e.g., SUSAN-2026)
Ensure uniqueness by appending number if duplicate exists
Store in User.referralCode field
Send email to guest with their new referral code
Create /dashboard/referrals page for guests to see their code and stats
Display: referral code, shareable link, clicks, applications, bookings
Copy to clipboard button for referral link
tRPC procedures: user.getMyReferralCode, user.getReferralStats
All tests pass, TypeScript compiles

userStories.title: Post-Trip Completion Bonus
acceptanceCriteria: Create daily cron job at /api/cron/referral-completion-bonus
Check for trips that ended yesterday
For each completed booking with referredBy: Award 500 bonus points
Create ReferralEvent with type COMPLETION
Send email notification to referrer about completion bonus
Prevent duplicate bonus awards (check if already awarded)
Update referral status to COMPLETED
All tests pass, TypeScript compiles

userStories.title: Referral Analytics Admin Dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Create /dashboard/admin/referral-analytics page
Referral funnel visualization: Clicks -> Applications -> Bookings -> Completed
Conversion rates at each stage
Top 10 performing referrers (partners and guests combined)
Referral source breakdown chart (partner vs guest vs organic)
Date range filter (last 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, all time)
Total points awarded summary
tRPC procedures: admin.getReferralFunnelStats, admin.getTopReferrers, admin.getReferralSourceBreakdown
All tests pass, TypeScript compiles

userStories.title: UTM Parameter Tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Capture UTM parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign) on all pages
Store UTM params in referral events and application/booking records
Display UTM data in admin referral analytics
Filter analytics by UTM source
All tests pass, TypeScript compiles

userStories.title: Unit Tests for Referral System
acceptanceCriteria: Tests for referral link cookie setting
Tests for referral attribution at application
Tests for referral attribution at booking
Tests for guest referral code generation
Tests for completion bonus cron job
Tests for referral analytics queries
Minimum 80% coverage on new referral code
All tests pass with vitest
